outcome: Opening an Attraction puts an Attraction card from the command zone onto the battlefield.
At the start of a precombat main phase the active player, if they control an Attraction, rolls a die to visit their Attractions.
A visit ability triggers when the roll to visit matches one of the Attraction's lit-up numbers, and does not otherwise.
A card with an Astrotorium back that would go to a zone other than the battlefield, exile or command zone goes to its owner's command zone instead.

note: the junkyard pile is a physical arrangement and not a zone
